sources.title: LFM3-Omni-2B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Omni Models LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI’s first omni model: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video, and audio, and answers in text, speech, or interleaved text and speech. It is built for on-device use, where one model replaces a separate ASR model, vision-language model, LLM, and TTS model. It is a non-reasoning model.
